item.title: The Husband's Secret
item.description:
The Husband’s Secret by Liane Moriarty

Summary

“The Husband’s Secret” is a compelling novel by Liane Moriarty that weaves the lives of three women together through the mystery of a sealed letter. The women, Cecilia, Tess, and Rachel, are linked by secrets and the impact of one man’s confession. Cecilia Fitzpatrick, a successful businesswoman and mother, discovers a letter from her husband with instructions to open it only in the event of his death. The revelation inside the letter has profound effects on not just her life, but also those of Tess and Rachel.
